biomes.name: Training grounds
biomes.rule: Normal immediate movement and full visibility; no added modifier.
biomes.response: Use cover, timing and existing dash/parry without an environmental penalty.
biomes.implementation: Normal motion; selected per run load independently of layout.

biomes.name: Snow / ice
biomes.rule: Acceleration and braking replace instantaneous starts and stops.
biomes.response: Release movement earlier, brake before corners, choose wider approaches.
biomes.implementation: Per-room acceleration/braking; layout-specific tuning. Dash exit capped at walking speed; blocked velocity components cleared. Reset/retry begins at rest.

biomes.name: Marsh / mist
biomes.rule: Reduced distant visibility, with readable landmarks and guaranteed warning cues.
biomes.response: Scout from cover, remember landmarks, avoid committing into an unseen threat.
biomes.implementation: Cached radial fog with layout-specific clear/fade radii. Enemies acquire and retain targets only in the clear circle; telegraphs and all projectiles draw above fog. Tab preserves landmarks but hides distant enemies.

biomes.name: Crosswind heights
biomes.rule: A cued world-direction force changes all projectile velocities during gusts. Ground movement stays normal; shots parallel to the wind also gain or lose speed.
biomes.response: Wait for a lull, compensate aim, move closer or use melee and cover.
biomes.implementation: Three seconds calm, one-second warning, eight-second gust; direction/strength authored per layout. Shared midpoint displacement for player/enemy/Echo/reflected shots; range counts travelled path. Reset/retry restarts calm.

biomes.name: Bamboo grove
biomes.rule: Solid bamboo walls: each cluster absorbs three shots or one slash. The breaking shot is consumed. Clear bypass routes remain.
biomes.response: Preserve cover, cut a movement shortcut or firing lane, or go around while enemies wear down the wall.
biomes.implementation: 124 authored wall segments expand into 894 clusters across all 18 layouts. Full visible shot bounds, solid ground footprints, damage notches, three-shot/one-slash destruction, reset/retry restoration. Required encounters and route alternatives stay reachable with walls intact.
